description: Broken link finder: read a page and the pages of the same site it links to, level by level (depth 0 is the start page only; up to 50 pages and 90 seconds), and check every link found once: pages, other sites and images. Returns the broken links with the link text and the pages that contain them, apart from links that could not be verified (blocked, rate limited, slow) and redirects. Respects robots.txt for pages it walks into. Needs an API key.

depth.description: Levels of pages to follow from the start page, 0 to 3.
depth.title: Depth

max_pages.description: How many pages to read, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

url.description: Start page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are walked; links to other sites are checked but not followed.
url.title: Url

name: find_broken_links
